latest_release.name: Apprise v2.2.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
This release has a few bugfixes, but introuces a slew of (12) new services bringing the total supported services up to **183**. The foundation of the Apprise library has now made it very easy to just scan missing service's upstream APIs and add them to our catalog.  There are so many examples now to use as reference. A big kudos to @LuisFigueroaG for all of your contributions for the last 2 releases; I really appeciate it!

**Note:** There is a security fix in this release: **GHSA-cfp4-m43r-v9q4**

###  :mega: New Notification Services
* Add Groundmail notification support (groundmail://) by @Ktryberceo in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1838
* Added Infobip support in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1843
* Added CM.com support in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1846
* Added Telesign support in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1847
* Gupshup Support added in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1848
* added Kaleyra Support in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1849
* Added KakaoTalk support in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1852
* Added xMatters support in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1851
* Whapi.Cloud WhatsApp support in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1854 and https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1857
* FireHydrant Signals support in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1858
* Nostr support with private messages and attachments in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1861
* Add SMSTunnel SMS notification support (smstunnel://) by @narcisbodea in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1863

### :lady_beetle:  Bugfixes
* Fix rsyslog:// multiplying the facility twice in the PRI value by @LuisFigueroaG in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1837
* Make tag checks on a service case-insensitive in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1844
* Fix d7sms:// batch=yes raising a TypeError on a failed send by @LuisFigueroaG in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1839
* Keep a line break written between inline tags for Telegram by @xubenqiang in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1842
* Fix reddit:// ignoring ad= and replies= by @LuisFigueroaG in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1845
* Fix psafer:// ignoring priority= by @LuisFigueroaG in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1850
* Fix xml:// ignoring GET params (-param=) by @LuisFigueroaG in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1856
* IPV6 hardening and TLS timeouts are tied to same globally defined one in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1862
* support blank data as input on incident reporting in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1859
* Fix burstsms:// ignoring validity= and rejecting uppercase country= by @LuisFigueroaG in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1860
* General hardening of codebase in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1868
* Fix lametric:// cloud mode not sending X-Access-Token by @LuisFigueroaG in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1865
* Add Bark subtitle, copy, action, archive, ttl, id and delete support by @fmontagna in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1869
* Keep CC display names in Postmark, Resend and Groundmail URLs by @Cassian433 in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1875
* Zulip messages without a title no longer fail in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1877

## :bulb: Features
* Apprise works without markdown package installed in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1876

### :heart: Life-Cycle Support
* Handle's click v8.5 deprecation notice in https://github.com/caronc/apprise/pull/1855

## Installation
Apprise is available [on PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/apprise/) through _pip_:
```bash
# Install Apprise v2.2.0 from PyPI
pip install apprise==2.2.0
```

If you use [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/), you can install the `apprise` command in its own isolated environment, or add Apprise to your uv project:
```bash
# Install the apprise command
uv tool install apprise=
